quote_candidates.quote: Opening a pull request still depends on that coding tool’s own GitHub or codebase connection, not on a Pylon MCP "create PR" tool.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: How do you set up the Pylon MCP server?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Make sure each user or API token identity that connects has the MCP Access permission, which the standard Member and Admin roles include.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Open the MCP Server settings in Pylon

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In Pylon, go to Settings → AI Controls → MCP Server.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Copy your workspace’s regional MCP URL from Installation.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Add the URL in your AI tool’s MCP settings, or for ChatGPT install the Pylon app from Settings > Plugins.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Auth is OAuth 2.0 or an API token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: EU server: mcp.eu.usepylon.com

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See Pylon’s MCP docs for the full tool list.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See the MCP setup guide for client steps.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See how to connect Pylon to ChatGPT with MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See how to connect Pylon to Claude with MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: MCP is an open standard that lets AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor connect to external products.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Pylon’s MCP server exposes your Pylon workspace (issues, accounts, contacts, and more) to those tools over OAuth 2.0 or an API token, so your team can query and act on support data from the AI clients they already use.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Which AI tools can connect to Pylon via MCP?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Pylon’s MCP server works with MCP clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For ChatGPT, the fastest path is Pylon’s native ChatGPT app; you can also add the regional MCP URL as a custom connector.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Headless workers, scripts, and clients that support custom authorization headers can connect with an existing Pylon API token instead of OAuth.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: What actions can an AI tool take in Pylon through MCP?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Connected AI tools can search and update issues, post internal notes, and send customer replies, which AI tools are instructed to show you for approval before sending.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Feature requests and some other tools require additional plan features.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Is the Pylon MCP server secure?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Connections use OAuth 2.0 or an API token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Actions run as the signed-in user or the token’s identity, with that identity’s current role and permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The identity also needs the MCP Access permission, which the standard Member and Admin roles include.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: How do I set up the Pylon MCP server?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Open Settings → AI Controls → MCP Server in Pylon, copy your regional URL (https://mcp.usepylon.com or https://mcp.eu.usepylon.com), and add it in your AI tool (or install the ChatGPT app).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Sign in with OAuth, or send an existing API token in an Authorization: Bearer header if your client supports it.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Is the Pylon MCP server on every plan?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The pricing Features by tier table lists the Pylon MCP server on Professional, Advanced, and Enterprise.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Some individual MCP tools still require add-ons or plan features such as Account Intelligence.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: # How do I connect to the Pylon MCP Server?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The Pylon MCP server at https://mcp.usepylon.com provides AI tools access to your Pylon data.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The endpoint uses HTTPS, so the connection is protected with TLS.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It uses OAuth authentication with your Pylon account.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The application you connect to Pylon's MCP will only have access to data you would have access to in Pylon, and will read and write on behalf of you.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: claude mcp add pylon --transport http https://mcp.usepylon.com/

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Then, in Claude Code, run the `/mcp` command and select the `pylon` MCP to authenticate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: `--transport http` selects MCP's Streamable HTTP transport and stateless request handling; it does not mean that the connection is unencrypted or uses a plaintext HTTP URL.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The Pylon endpoint remains HTTPS/TLS-protected.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In "Admin Settings", add a custom connector named "Pylon" with URL `https://mcp.usepylon.com/`

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Leave "OAuth Client ID" and "OAuth Client Secret" blank.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Navigate to "Settings > Connectors" and click the "Connect" button next to the Pylon MCP to authenticate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Add to your Cursor MCP settings:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: "url": "https://mcp.usepylon.com/"

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Navigate to "Cursor Settings > Tools & MCP" and click "Connect" next to the Pylon MCP to authenticate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **Note:** The Pylon MCP server only supports OAuth authentication.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: API key authentication is not currently available, which may affect usage in remote environments or platforms that don't support OAuth for remote connections.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **Current capabilities:** The Pylon MCP server provides access to issues, accounts, and contacts, as well as knowledge base articles and collections, macros, tags, and triggers.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The MCP server does not currently support fetching notebook block content directly.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When the MCP client connects, it will open your browser

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Log in with your Pylon account credentials

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The browser will redirect back and complete the OAuth flow

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Your MCP client is now connected to Pylon!

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **Headless or bot-only clients:** The Pylon MCP server does not currently support API keys, machine-to-machine credentials, or other non-OAuth authentication methods.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If your client cannot complete the browser-based OAuth flow, it cannot connect directly to the Pylon MCP server today.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If you need token-based access for a supported integration or automation, use the Pylon REST API instead of MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The REST API accepts Bearer API tokens, but that authentication method does not apply to the Pylon MCP server.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: OAuth sessions expire periodically.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The exact duration varies by MCP client - some sessions last a few hours, others can last several days.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When your session expires, you may see authentication errors or your MCP tools may stop returning results.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Claude Code:** Run `/mcp` and re-authenticate the Pylon connection

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Cursor:** Go to **Cursor Settings > Tools & MCP** and click "Connect" next to Pylon

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **Seat requirement:** You need a **Member** or **Admin** seat to connect to the MCP server.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Viewer and Integration users cannot authenticate and will see an "Authorization failed" error.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If you hit this, ask your workspace admin to upgrade your seat type in **Settings > Users**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: How to authenticate with Pylon's API

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The Pylon API uses [Bearer](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750#section-2.1) authentication.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This means you’ll need to pass your API token in the header of your request:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Generate an API token in the [Pylon dashboard](https://app.usepylon.com/settings/api-tokens).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Pylon’s API is available in two regions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Both regions use the same API endpoints and authentication.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can tell a token's region from its prefix:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Sending a token to the other region's API returns `401` with the `wrong\_region\_token` error code, and the message names the correct URL.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Once you've created a token, call the [`/me`](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/api-reference/me.md) endpoint to retrieve details about your organization and confirm your token works.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Go to \*\*Settings > Integrations & dev > API\*\*.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: On the \*\*Tokens\*\* tab, click \*\*Create API Token\*\*.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* Leave \*\*Act as user or bot (optional)\*\* empty to give the token its own identity.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The token uses that user's current role and permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Click \*\*Create\*\* and copy the token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: A token with its own identity uses the role you pick when you create it.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Older tokens that have no role act as Admin.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: A token that acts as a user or bot has no role of its own.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It always uses that user's current role, so changing the user's role changes what the token can do.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*Token with its own identity:\*\* actions show up under the token's name and icon.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*Token that acts as a user or bot:\*\* actions are attributed to that user or bot.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Bots are identities for automation, so API activity is attributed to the bot instead of to a teammate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Then select the bot under \*\*Act as user or bot\*\* when you create a token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Add IP addresses (for example `203.0.113.10`) or CIDR blocks (for example `203.0.113.0/24`) to restrict where the token can be used.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If the list is empty, the token works from any IP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Pylon checks the public IP address your requests come from, so add the public egress IPs or ranges of the servers that call the API.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The \*\*Tokens\*\* tab shows each token's \*\*Acts as\*\*, \*\*Token preview\*\*, \*\*Role\*\*, \*\*Created by\*\*, \*\*Last used\*\*, and \*\*Created\*\* values.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: From the \*\*…\*\* menu on a token you can:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*Duplicate Token:\*\* create a new token with the same settings.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*Rotate:\*\* generate a new token value.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The current token stops working immediately.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*Delete:\*\* permanently revoke the token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: \* \*\*View Activity:\*\* open the token's request logs.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Go to \*\*Settings > Integrations & dev > API\*\* and open the \*\*Logs\*\* tab, or choose \*\*View Activity\*\* from a token's \*\*…\*\* menu to see only that token's requests.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Filter by token, or choose \*\*All tokens\*\*, and by a date range of up to 90 days.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Each request shows when it was made, the token, who it acted as, the method, endpoint, response status, source IP, user agent, and request ID.

quote_candidates.quote: # Call Lark MCP server in remote mode (Deprecated)

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Lark Open Platform provides a remote MCP Server configuration feature that supports the Streamable HTTP transmission protocol, allowing users to securely and efficiently integrate and use rich Lark open capabilities in cloud scenarios with AI agents such as Cursor, Trae, Claude, and n8n via one-click integration.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Create a remote MCP service on the Lark MCP Configuration Platform and customize tools (i.e., Lark Open Platform server-side APIs) to flexibly build the MCP tools your business needs.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: All tools are called via API under the identity of the currently logged-in user (user\_access\_token).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * During the configuration process, the system guides you to complete the authorization operation for the logged-in user with one click.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The MCP Server can only call tools on behalf of the user after authorization.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The remote MCP Server configuration feature supports automatic refreshing of the token before expiration.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Log in to the Lark MCP Configuration Platform.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The remote MCP Server configuration function is in internal testing.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: On the left side of the page, click **New MCP Service**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the **MCP tool settings** area, confirm the current user identity.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When using MCP to manage Lark business resources, the current displayed user will be used.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For example, if your business needs MCP to manage Lark Multidimensional Tables, select Multidimensional Tables.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Click **Add**, then in the pop-up **Get user authorization** dialog, confirm the authorization user login info and the permissions obtained by Lark MCP app, then click **Authorize**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After successful addition, in the **How to use MCP server** area, select the **Transmission mode**, and view the **Server URL and JSON**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Server URL and JSON**: Configure these links into your AI agents so they can remotely connect to Lark MCP services.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Other AI agents can set URL or JSON in their respective MCP configuration interfaces.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After configuring the Lark MCP service, quick add entries for Trae and Cursor appear at the bottom of the service page for fast installation.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the **MCP Tools** area, inside the **Install MCP Server?** card, click **Install**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After successful installation, the MCP Tools list will appear as shown below.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Take Cursor as an example, to use Lark MCP services inside the AI agent.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Write prompt instructions so that the agent, based on a screenshot sample of a multi-dimensional table, uses Lark open API to batch read contents from cloud documents and extract the information into a multi-dimensional table, and finally drafts a technical solution document in Lark Docs.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ### How to rename or delete a configured MCP Server?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Log in to the Lark MCP Configuration Platform.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the left **Created MCP Services** list, select the service you want to operate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Log in to the Lark MCP Configuration Platform.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the left **Created MCP Services** list, select the service you want to operate.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the **MCP Tool Configuration** area, under **Add Tool** card, click **Edit**, modify the selected tool, and save.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After modification, refresh or restart the MCP service in the AI tool.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ### What causes abnormal MCP Tools status display in Cursor?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Symptom: After one-click installing MCP service to Cursor, the tool status indicator shows red.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Reason: The status indicator may show red due to tool influence, generally not affecting MCP tool use.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Solution: You can ignore this status, directly send requests in AI Chat, and judge based on AI response whether Lark MCP tool can be called normally.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If not, reconfigure the remote MCP service and one-click install it to Cursor, then retry.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Development document search MCP Integration

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The MCP tool supports a wide range of command parameters, allowing flexible configuration for suitable MCP startup commands.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The lark-mcp tool must be installed.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Run the following command in your local terminal to install lark-mcp.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: npm install @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp -g

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If the terminal returns the message `It is likely you do not have the permissions to access this file as the current user`, you need to run the command as an administrator:`sudo npm install @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp@beta -g`.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Run `lark-mcp -V` to check the MCP version.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If the version is lower than 0.4.0, it is recommended to uninstall and reinstall lark-mcp:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Uninstall lark-mcp: `npm uninstall @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp -g`

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Reinstall lark-mcp: `npm install @larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp -g`

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Run `lark-mcp -V` again to verify the version information.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: (Optional) Globally install OpenAPI MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: There are two installation methods for the MCP tool: global installation and NPX installation.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * NPX installation: described in the Install and use OpenAPI MCP document.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After installing lark-mcp locally, you can use the MCP tool persistently (supported command parameters are referred to in the **Command Parameters** section below).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For details, see Install and use OpenAPI MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Execute the following command to log in to OpenAPI MCP as a user:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: lark-mcp login -a <your_app_id> -s <your_app_secret>

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can log in to the Lark Developer Console, and on the **Credentials & Basic Info** page of your created custom app details, obtain the **App ID** and **App Secret**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The terminal will display a URL for user authorization.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You need to visit this URL within 60 seconds and complete the authorization.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The authorization page looks like the image below.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Ensure the user identity is as expected, and click **Authorize** so that the MCP tool can obtain the user access token (`user_access_token`).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After successful authorization, the terminal will echo `success`.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: In the tool settings, select **Tools & Integrations > MCP Tools > Add Custom MCP**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can log in to the Lark Developer Console, and on the **Credentials & Basic Info** page of your created custom app details, obtain the **App ID** and **App Secret**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: After configuration, you need to disable and then re-enable lark-mcp.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: A properly running lark-mcp appears as shown below:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: `lark-mcp login` is used to log in as a user and obtain the user identity credential (user\_access\_token).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--domain` | `-d` | The API domain for Lark Open Platform, default is the Lark domain.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--scope` | None | Used to specify the API permissions for the user identity credential (user\_access\_token).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Manually specified permissions must fall within the API permission scope that the application has applied for.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For how to apply for application permissions, refer to Apply for API Permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * To enable automatic refreshing of user\_access\_token, the manually specified permissions must include the `offline_access` permission.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * If the `--scope` parameter is not specified, the user is granted all API permissions the application has applied for by default.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--scope offline_access doc:document` |

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: `lark-mcp logout` is used to log out a user and clear the user identity credential (user\_access\_token).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The supported command parameters of `lark-mcp mcp` are described in the table below.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--domain` | `-d` | API domain of the Lark Open Platform, default is the Lark domain.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--tools` | `-t` | List of MCP tools that need to be enabled.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Refer to tools and pass the corresponding **MCP tool names**.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Supports passing in multiple items (including individual API tools and preset toolset names), separated by commas.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Fully covered, after running this parameter, only the API tools included in `-t` are available.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--tool-name-case` | `-c` | Format of the MCP tool registration name.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--token-mode` | None | Specifies the Token type used when calling the API after the tool is started.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * tenant\_access\_token: Uses the application access token, and will filter out API tools that do not support tenant\_access\_token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * user\_access\_token: Uses the user access token, and will filter out API tools that do not support user\_access\_token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--user-access-token` | `-u` | User access token (user\_access\_token) for calling the API as a user.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `--oauth` | None | Configurable parameter for SSE/Streamable transmission mode, enabling automatic user identity login and authentication.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | `lark-mcp mcp -m sse -a <your_app_id> -s <your_app_secret> --oauth` |

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Parameters need to be configured in the MCP configuration file of the AI tool.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For example, the MCP configuration file for the Cursor tool is mcp.json.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ```    {  "mcpServers": {  "lark-mcp": {  "command": "npx",  "args": [  "-y",  "@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp",  "mcp",  "-a",  "<your_app_id>",  "-s",  "<your_app_secret>"  ]  }  }  } ``` |

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Specifies the Token type used when calling the API after the tool is started.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Specify the Token type through `--token-mode`.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * tenant\_access\_token: Uses the application access token, and will filter out API tools that do not support tenant\_access\_token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * user\_access\_token: Uses the user access token, and will filter out API tools that do not support user\_access\_token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ```    {  "mcpServers": {  "lark-mcp": {  "command": "npx",  "args": [  "-y",  "@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp",  "mcp",  "-a",  "<your_app_id>",  "-s",  "<your_app_secret>",  "--token-mode",  "tenant_access_token"  ]  }  }  } ``` |

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Using user access token (user\_access\_token) | If you need to call the API as a specific user, you can specify the user access token (user\_access\_token) using `-u`.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Refer to FAQ for how to quickly obtain the user access token (user\_access\_token) corresponding to the application.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ```    {  "mcpServers": {  "lark-mcp": {  "command": "npx",  "args": [  "-y",  "@larksuiteoapi/lark-mcp",  "mcp",  "-a",  "<your_app_id>",  "-s",  "<your_app_secret>",  "-u",  "<your_user_access_token>"  ]  }  }  } ``` |

quote_candidates.quote: | Setting MCP tool language to Chinese | Specify the tool language using `-l`.

quote_candidates.quote: If you encounter token limit issues when integrating with the large model, consider using the default English (en).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **모델 컨텍스트 프로토콜(MCP)**은 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)이 외부 데이터 및 애플리케이션과 안전하게 상호작용할 수 있도록 하는 개방형 표준입니다.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **Google Ads MCP 서버**는 Google Ads API에 대한 표준화된 브리지를 제공합니다.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **GitHub 저장소:** google-ads-mcp 저장소에서 데모와 예시를 찾고, 버그를 신고하고, 기능을 제안할 수 있습니다.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **커뮤니티:** Google 광고 커뮤니티 Discord의 `#ads-api-ai-tools` 채널에 참여하세요.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Google Ads MCP 서버를 통합하면 Google Ads API 인증, 리소스 가져오기, 데이터 파싱, 지원되는 확장 소재 또는 라벨 변형을 위한 커스텀 코드를 작성할 필요가 없습니다.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **인증:** 로컬 `stdio`의 애플리케이션 기본 사용자 인증 정보(OAuth 2.0 사용자 인증 정보 또는 서비스 계정) 또는 원격 HTTP의 OAuth 2.0 웹 애플리케이션 사용자 인증 정보

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **컨텍스트 삽입:** MCP 서버는 구조화된 쿼리 결과 또는 제안된 `change_items` 항목과 확인 `checksum` 다이제스트를 LLM의 컨텍스트 창에 반환합니다.

quote_candidates.quote: ### OAuth Client Credentials flow

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The OAuth setup flow works as follows.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You must also provide two URLs, the HTTP `POST` URL endpoint for your app and a URL to an authorization server or OAuth service.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When you give Twilio SendGrid all of this information, it will pass the Client ID and Client Secret to the Token URL (your authorization server/OAuth service).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The authorization server will then use the Client ID and Client Secret to generate an access token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This token is sent back to Twilio SendGrid.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The access token is meaningless to SendGrid.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It acts only as a key to pass back to your app at the HTTP `POST` URL endpoint.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This will be done in an Authorization header.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Because this access token is shared among only your app, the authorization server, and SendGrid, you can trust requests delivered with the token are from a trusted source.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can verify the access token is legitimate by checking with the authorization server that created it.

quote_candidates.quote: # MCP (Model Context Protocol) for WooCommerce

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: MCP for WooCommerce by W7S connects your store to AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the open standard for letting tools like Claude and ChatGPT work with outside systems.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: WooCommerce’s own MCP support covers a narrow set of product and order operations, and from WooCommerce 11.3 it needs an Application Password and manual setup.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: MCP for WooCommerce runs its own MCP server through the free MCP Adapter plugin and builds it out: a connector form for Claude.ai, a downloadable bundle for Claude Desktop, guided setup for ChatGPT, and a wide set of store operations across orders, products, customers, coupons, refunds, tax, shipping, reports, and more.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You stay in control of access through your WooCommerce API keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Spend less time in WP Admin.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Each connection runs under a WooCommerce API key, and a read-only key cannot create, update, or delete anything.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The same store connects to Claude and to ChatGPT, and to other MCP-compatible clients.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.quote: ## Is MCP for WooCommerce ready for WooCommerce 11.3?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: WordPress and WooCommerce are moving AI connections to the free MCP Adapter plugin: from WooCommerce 11.3, WooCommerce removes its own MCP endpoint, the address every earlier version of this extension connected through, and the copy of the adapter it bundled.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It runs its own MCP server through the MCP Adapter plugin, so your store keeps answering your AI assistants through WooCommerce 11.3 and later.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Existing connections carry over:** your API keys, Claude.ai and ChatGPT connector URLs, Claude Desktop bundles, and saved configs carry over without replacement.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Installs the free MCP Adapter plugin in one click:** if your store doesn’t have it yet, an **Install and activate MCP Adapter** button in WP Admin and on the Connection tab installs it from WordPress.org and activates it without leaving the page.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Readiness checks name the adapter:** Site Readiness checks the MCP Adapter first and tells you which copy is loaded and what to do next, so “not connecting” has a clear answer.

quote_candidates.quote: # Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: With the MCP Adapter plugin, AI clients can discover and run these store operations through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), subject to WordPress and WooCommerce permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI applications to securely connect to external data sources and tools.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Using MCP with WooCommerce relies on two core technologies:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * WordPress Abilities API - A standardized system for registering capabilities in WordPress, included in WordPress core

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * WordPress MCP Adapter - The core MCP protocol implementation, installed as the MCP Adapter plugin

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This architecture allows WooCommerce to expose operations as MCP tools through the flexible WordPress Abilities system while maintaining existing security and permission models.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: MCP for WooCommerce by W7S connects your store to AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the open standard for letting tools like Claude and ChatGPT work with outside systems.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: WooCommerce’s own MCP support covers a narrow set of product and order operations, and from WooCommerce 11.3 it needs an Application Password and manual setup.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: MCP for WooCommerce runs its own MCP server through the free MCP Adapter plugin and builds it out: a connector form for Claude.ai, a downloadable bundle for Claude Desktop, guided setup for ChatGPT, and a wide set of store operations across orders, products, customers, coupons, refunds, tax, shipping, reports, and more.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You stay in control of access through your WooCommerce API keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Spend less time in WP Admin.

quote_candidates.quote: Each connection runs under a WooCommerce API key, and a read-only key cannot create, update, or delete anything.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The same store connects to Claude and to ChatGPT, and to other MCP-compatible clients.

quote_candidates.quote: ## Is MCP for WooCommerce ready for WooCommerce 11.3?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: WordPress and WooCommerce are moving AI connections to the free MCP Adapter plugin: from WooCommerce 11.3, WooCommerce removes its own MCP endpoint, the address every earlier version of this extension connected through, and the copy of the adapter it bundled.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It runs its own MCP server through the MCP Adapter plugin, so your store keeps answering your AI assistants through WooCommerce 11.3 and later.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Existing connections carry over:** your API keys, Claude.ai and ChatGPT connector URLs, Claude Desktop bundles, and saved configs carry over without replacement.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Installs the free MCP Adapter plugin in one click:** if your store doesn’t have it yet, an **Install and activate MCP Adapter** button in WP Admin and on the Connection tab installs it from WordPress.org and activates it without leaving the page.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Readiness checks name the adapter:** Site Readiness checks the MCP Adapter first and tells you which copy is loaded and what to do next, so “not connecting” has a clear answer.

quote_candidates.quote: # Connect Booking & Appointment Plugin to AI Assistants Using MCP

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: With the Booking & Appointment Plugin’s AI Abilities via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), you can interact with your WooCommerce booking data using natural language through an AI assistant.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You choose whether to enable MCP and connect a supported AI client to your store.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Ensure you’re using version **8.6.0** or later that supports AI Abilities via MCP.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * An MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can also use other AI clients that support custom MCP servers, such as ChatGPT Desktop.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This is required to run the WordPress MCP server which securely connects your AI client to your WordPress website.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.quote: OAuth authentication with Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source is based on OAuth 1.0a, an open standard for secure API authentication.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: OAuth is a token-passing mechanism that allows a system to control which third-party applications have access to internal data without revealing or storing any user IDs or passwords.

quote_candidates.quote: ## Web API clients and authentication methods

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Each type of client has a preferred authentication method.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: To authenticate, use the authentication method for your preferred client:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Registered users use token-based authentication to make web API calls using a mobile application.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: As a registered account user, you request a token from the Magento token service at the endpoint that is defined for your user type.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The token service returns a unique authentication token in exchange for a username and password for an admin or customer account.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: To prove your identity, specify this token in the

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: request header on web API calls.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ### Third-party application authentication

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Third-party applications use OAuth-based authentication to access the web APIs.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ### JavaScript widget authentication (storefront or Admin)

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Registered users use session-based authentication to log in to the storefront or Admin.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: As a customer, you log in to the storefront with your customer credentials.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: As an administrator, you log in to the Admin with your administrator credentials.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The web API framework identifies you and controls access to the requested resource.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The following sections describe tips about which type of authentication method you should use depending on your use case.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ### Token based (Bearer Authentication)

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Admin Token—Use this token in applications to authorize an Admin user and access Admin-related APIs.

quote_candidates.quote: Request a token and then include it in future requests.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.quote: ## Admin and customer access tokens

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ##  How do I authenticate with API Key?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: An API key is a secure hashed token used to authenticate with Bright Data API.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: You can create additional API keys for different users and with different permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Manage your API Keys anytime in the Account settings.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ###  How do I relay the API key within a request?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The important part of this request is the `Authorization` header:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This `<token>` is your **API key**, which is required for every API request.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ###  How do I authenticate with the CLI, Python SDK and JavaScript SDK?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: The Bright Data CLI, Python SDK and JavaScript SDK use the same API key.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Pass the key once when you set up the client, and every request the client sends carries the `Authorization` header for you.

quote_candidates.quote: npm install -g @brightdata/cli

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * The JavaScript SDK and the Python SDK (version 2.5.0 and later) also read `BRIGHTDATA_API_KEY`, so one variable covers the CLI and both SDKs.

quote_candidates.quote: ###  How do I generate a new API key?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: To generate a new API key, follow these steps:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: only admins can generate API keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Note: Each user can generate only one API key.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ###  What are API Key options and configuration?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When creating an API key, you can assign one of five permission levels to control access and ensure security based on user roles or use cases.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ####  What permissions level does an API key have?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: There are 5 types of permissions to choose from to control API key access:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Admin:** Grants full access to the account, including all Billing, Financial, product settings and configurations.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Ops:** Allows access to proxy/API configurations but restricts Billing access.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **Limit:** Permits management of proxy passwords and IP allowlists/denylists.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **User:** Enables API usage on the proxy/API level without access to Billing or product configuration pages.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ####  Does the API Key have an expiration date?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When creating an API key, you can setup its expiration date.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ####  How can I view the API Key settings and configuration?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ####  Why can’t I see a plain text version of my API Key, or copy it?

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: For your security, we do not allow plain text view of API keys with `admin` permissions.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.quote: # Build a Code Mode MCP server

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: A Code Mode MCP server lets any Model Context Protocol (MCP) client use model-written code without providing its own sandbox.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Pattern | MCP tools | Model-facing API | Use when |

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Single code tool | `code` | Typed methods for every upstream tool | You already have an MCP server with a manageable set of tools.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: | Search and execute | `search`, `execute` | OpenAPI document and request function | You have a large API whose complete schema should stay out of context.

quote_candidates.quote: # Create an API-based integration

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This page guides Technology Partners through creating an official Datadog API integration.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ## Building an API integration

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: These steps assume you’ve joined the Datadog Partner Network, have access to a partner developer organization, and have created a listing in the Developer Platform.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard authorization framework that enables secure access to Datadog APIs without exposing user credentials.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: It issues scoped, revocable tokens, offering stronger security and a better user experience than API or application keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: OAuth is available only to approved Technology Partners developing official Datadog integrations.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Standalone OAuth clients are not supported.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This affects both the OAuth handshake and the API endpoints you use.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * To submit data to Datadog, your integration must request the `api_keys_write` scope and make an API call during the OAuth handshake to create an API key on behalf of the user.

quote_candidates.quote: The API authenticates using access tokens (API keys).

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: This article provides best practices to consider when working with the Smartsheet API and any access tokens (API keys), or other sensitive information.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: When choosing an authentication method, it is important to consider your integration scenario.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **If your scenario involves user consent and interaction,** it's typically best to use OAuth with Smartsheet.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Note that the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See OAuth Walkthrough for details.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * **If your scenario is strictly machine-to-machine,** execute raw token requests over HTTPS.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: See Access Token Best Practices for details.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Each scenario requires an HTTP authorization header containing an access token.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: > **Warning**: If an unauthorized user gets a copy of this token, they will be able to access all Smartsheet data that you have access to, both to read and modify on your behalf.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: ## Access Token Best Practices

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: Never commit access tokens (API keys) to accessible version control systems like GitHub or BitBucket.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If you have mistakenly deployed API keys to a publicly accessible location such as GitHub, then you should immediately revoke those API keys, revise your application to use a preferred method of key deployment, and then generate new keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If you need to store API keys in a database, consider the following protections:

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Restrict access so API keys are only readable by the owner of the object

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: * Make sure your database or the disk the database is on is set to encrypt data at rest

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: > **Note**: When using any Smartsheet SDK, you can use the environment variable of `SMARTSHEET_ACCESS_TOKEN`.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If the access token is null on input to the client builder, the SDK will automatically pick up the value of that environment variable.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: If you've committed code to a repository before implementing these security best practices, here are some steps to secure your API keys.

quote_candidates.source_type: cached official-domain candidate; vendor affiliation still requires review
quote_candidates.quote: **For OAuth with Smartsheet:** Work through the OAuth Walkthrough to regenerate client secrets, auth codes, and tokens.
